steps.instruction: On dashboard '{{runid}} Bench Dashboard' (uid {{02-create.url.p1}}): set the dashboard time range to 'Last 6 hours' (via the top time picker), add the tag 'bench' to the dashboard (via Dashboard settings → General → Tags), and when saving, make sure the save dialog option to update the dashboard's default time range IS ticked so the 6-hour range persists in the saved dashboard. Save. Then verify persistence: reload the page, open Dashboard settings → General and confirm the tag 'bench' is listed, and confirm the saved default time range is Last 6 hours (e.g. by opening a fresh new browser tab to the dashboard and checking the time picker, or checking the settings' time range). Report what you observe.

recorded.discriminating_test: saving with the tick at 'Last 5 minutes' made the plain URL show 'Last 5 minutes', proving the ticked option rewrites the persisted default; re-saving with the tick at 6h restored 'Last 6 hours'

Verify persistence after a hard reload of /d/{{02-create.url.p1}}/{{runid}}-bench-dashboard (no URL params): the refresh picker shows 1m, and if you check the dashboard settings/JSON, the default refresh is 1m.
